scope: Historical manual semantic feasibility assessment before the scalar-function extension. Per-rule classifications, reasons and capability descriptions describe that baseline and have not been reassessed. Current operation support and actual proofs are recorded in data/hlo_support.json and results/verification.json; no manual classification counts as verification.

statuses.candidate: The mathematical schema fits the current compiler vocabulary; general explicit-rule verification is not established.
statuses.restricted: A meaningful specialization fits; the full catalog schema is not covered.
statuses.proof_gap: The relevant operations can be represented, but a required proof/constructor capability is missing or a current check fails.
statuses.unsupported: A required general operation or value/index semantic feature is absent.

routes.bundled: Uses supplied semantic operations; additional explicit rules/constructors may be needed.
routes.dialect: Can specialize or add declarations with existing compiler primitives; no compiler change proposed.
routes.compiler: A missing semantic/proof capability prevents the general translation.

literal.description: Fixed signed-integer constants, without tensor literal inspection/extraction

nonpolynomial.description: No general tensor division, powers, min/max or transcendental scalar primitives

bitwise.description: No tensor logical, shift, bitwise or fixed-width conversion semantics

complex.description: No general real/imaginary component projection primitives

value_analysis.description: Metadata assumptions are not tensor element range analysis

axis_order.description: Ordered interfaces, selection and permutation composition

broadcast.description: Insertion-only broadcast; does not expand an existing size-one axis

reshape.description: Sample reshape has shape checks; semantic coordinate split/merge is missing

slice.description: Static nonnegative starts, positive sizes/strides, calculated affine reads

reverse.description: Reflection in original domains; same-selector cancellation and known-singleton removal

reduction.description: Reduce is summation; sum/product extraction and reduction concatenation

reduction_other.description: No generic reducer/comparator computation, tuple reduction or scatter semantics

reduction_reindex.description: Normalizer compares reduction domains and reads, without general bijective change of bound coordinates

cardinality.description: Coefficients are fixed int64, not products of symbolic extents

empty.description: Empty sum semantics exist; simplifying all empty-domain forms is not established

dot.description: Generalized dot with batch/contraction/free groups and same-type arithmetic

convolution.description: Valid fixed-layout ungrouped convolution with positive strides/dilations

piecewise.description: No coordinate-dependent branch to choose padding/concat/update values

dynamic.description: Index parameters are metadata; tensor-valued indices/clamping cannot be lowered

window.description: No supplied general reduce_window semantic operation

iota.description: Coordinate tuples can index Read but cannot become scalar tensor values

variadic.description: Arbitrary operand-list rewrites are outside the fixed-arity semantic pilot

modular.description: No modulo or wraparound coordinate primitive
